The card first stopped at its re-census (the 21 rows K3 left to this owner are Unknown on their store leaves alone; requiring the old member value custody-free inside the body left 0-4 readable) and resumed on option 1. A gate-refused store `P->F[.G...] = V` (or W45's sub-object store of a name) into a member of a formal no statement rebinds, `V` a call whose contract in force returns `Owned` or a local acquisition (pointer-to-pointer casts only), is the hand-off of `V`'s custody when every condition formula holds; each condition, the premise and each named refusal is a C04.18.9 typed-rendering formula over the new MES block (29 `mes_` terms, sorts `mes_site`, `mes_cell`) checked by the premise-formula validator, e.g. H1 `forall (#s: mes_site) { (#mes_occurs(#s,#mes_place) => (#s == #mes_store || #mes_null_test(#s))) }` and the stated premise `mes_caller_slot: forall (#o: obj) { (#mes_holds(#mes_place,#o) => !#mes_owed(#o)) }` (P-CG11-CALLER-SLOT), which every row holding a hand-off lists in its verdict assumptions and without which it is refused. The flow consumes the value (`resource_consumed(v, nullable)`) only for exactly one live identity of the body, under rule 10v's owner and old-value checks; the store is a rule-10v `PointerStore` of value class `member-handoff`, so no summary is published and every caller stays refused at the call. Deliberate re-pins of the admitted shape in nine gateway test files, each named in its test. ledger.title: The caller half of the member-effect store: a summary stating a hand-off into a formal's member, read at the call
ledger.text: Rule 38k (MEMBER-EFFECT-STORES body half) admits a body that hands an owned value into a member of its formal's object under the stated premise `mes_caller_slot` and withholds its summary, so every call of it stays refused (uncontracted). DISCHARGE: a summary form stating the hand-off (the member path and the custody it takes), read only by the direct-call route: a tracked parent gains a field link in CG11's owned-field model, an untracked member's old value is established custody-free at the call site (fail closed otherwise), so the premise is discharged rather than stated; a formal parent cascades. Lean parity; measured.

ledger.title: A hand-off store whose place is used after the store stays refused (mes_refuse_place_used)
ledger.text: Rule 38k refuses `exists (#s: mes_site) { (#mes_occurs(#s,#mes_place) && !(#s == #mes_store || #mes_null_test(#s))) }`: the SCRAM pair (`out->ptr = rd_malloc(..)` then `rd_snprintf(out->ptr, ..)` / `dst->ptr[i] = ..`), rd_kafka_topic_partition_set_metadata_from_rktp_stored (`memcpy(rktpar->metadata, ..)`) and Monkey mk_buffer_cat on the 2026-11-24 `current` report. DISCHARGE: borrowed uses of the handed-off place after the store (reads and writes through it at `resource_borrowed` positions) with a stated argument that no call between the store and the return can release or rebind the member; Lean parity; measured.

ledger.title: Realloc self-assignment into a formal's member stays refused without a non-null reallocation clause
ledger.text: Rule 38k refuses `(#mes_reallocates() && !#mes_nonnull_clause())`: rd_list_grow and rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_grow (`P->F = rd_realloc(P->F, n)`), since `rd_realloc` states `resource_return_reallocated(ptr, nullable)` although `rd.h` asserts the result. DISCHARGE: a rule-37 checked non-null `rd_realloc` specification (a provider change read at every call, with LIBC-REALLOC-SIZE-ZERO's size-zero case settled), then the realloc input as the place's own old value; Lean parity; measured.

ledger.title: Hand-off stores past a pointer hop below the formal or through a local alias of it stay refused
ledger.text: Rule 38k refuses `!#mes_in(#mes_place,#mes_parent)` (rd_kafkap_Fetch_reply_tags_set_topic, `reply_tags->Topics[TopicIdx].Partitions = rd_calloc(..)`) and `!#mes_formal_root()` (unpack_opts_unit, `map = (struct cmt_map *) context; map->unit = value`). DISCHARGE: an owner premise for the element object behind the hop, and a local initialised once from a formal (never rebound, never address-taken) read as the formal's object; Lean parity; measured.
